messages.content: In the Panchatantra, how does the monkey escape from the crocodile?

When the crocodile admits that his wife wants the monkey's heart, the monkey says he left his heart in the rose-apple tree. The crocodile swims back to fetch it, and the monkey climbs the tree to safety.
Why did Shell-Neck the turtle fall from the sky?
Two ganders carried him through the air on a stick he held in his mouth. When he heard people talking below, he opened his mouth to ask what they were saying, lost his grip and fell.
What lesson does the Panchatantra story of the lion-makers teach?
Knowledge without common sense is dangerous. Three learned men bring a dead lion back to life and are killed by it, while their friend with plain sense climbs a tree and survives.
How does a small rabbit get rid of the lion Numskull?
He leads the lion to a well and says a rival lion is hiding there. Numskull sees his own reflection, roars, hears the echo, jumps in to attack, and dies.
Who is Fierce-Howl in the Panchatantra, and how is he found out?

Fierce-Howl is a jackal who falls into an indigo vat, turns blue, and gets the forest animals to make him their king. He gives himself away when he hears other jackals howling and howls along with them.
Why does Bharat take Rama's sandals back with him?
Rama will not go back on his father's word and return as king. So Bharat takes his sandals as a sign of Rama's right to the throne and rules from Nandigrama in Rama's name until he returns.
What happens when Rama tries the great bow at King Janak's court?
Rama lifts the huge bow that no one else could handle and draws the string so hard that it breaks in two. Janak is amazed and gives his daughter Sita to Rama in marriage.
What token does Hanuman give Sita to show that Rama sent him?
He gives her Rama's golden ring, which has Rama's name engraved on it.
In Drona's archery test, what answer made Arjuna stand out?
The other pupils said they could see the tree, their teacher, their fellow pupils and the bird. Arjuna said he saw only the bird, and then only its head, so Drona let him shoot.
Who was Aruni of Panchala in the Mahabharata?
Aruni was a pupil of the sage Ayoda-Dhaumya. When he was sent to close a breach in a field's water channel and could not, he lay down in the gap himself to hold back the water.
On Yudhishthira's last journey, who was the dog that followed him?
The dog was really Dharma, the god of Righteousness, in disguise. Yudhishthira refused to enter heaven without the loyal dog, and Dharma praised him for his compassion.
How did Savitri win back Satyavan's life from Yama?
She followed Yama and spoke so wisely that he granted her boons. One boon was a hundred sons with Satyavan, which could not come true without him, so she asked for his life and Yama set him free.
What disguise did Arjuna choose for the year at King Virata's palace?
He chose to live as Vrihannala, one of the third sex, wearing bangles to hide the bowstring marks on his arms. He would teach the palace women singing, dancing and music.
Who does Alice follow down the rabbit-hole at the start of Alice in Wonderland?
She follows the White Rabbit, who takes a watch out of his waistcoat pocket and hurries off, saying he will be late.
In Pride and Prejudice, whom does Elizabeth Bennet get engaged to?
She gets engaged to Mr. Darcy. Jane can hardly believe it at first, and her father is surprised because Elizabeth used to dislike him.
Where is Jane Eyre sent to school after she leaves Gateshead?
She is sent to Lowood school. Mrs. Reed arranges it with Mr. Brocklehurst and asks that Jane be kept humble.
What is the name of Captain Ahab's ship in Moby-Dick?
The ship is called the Pequod. Ahab sails it on his hunt for the White Whale, Moby Dick.
Who narrates The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes?
Dr. Watson, Holmes's friend, tells the stories. He writes as "I" and often goes along with Holmes on his cases.
What is the difference between aroha and avaroha in a raga?
Aroha is the ascending, or rising, movement of a raga, and avaroha is the descending movement. They do not always use the same notes.
When is Raga Yaman usually sung, and which note matters most in its sound?
Yaman is an evening raga from the Kalyan thaat. Tivra Ma is central to it, so learners should avoid plain Ma.
